## Tone of Voice
- Messaging divided into three tiers: Brand Lines, User/Community Quotes, and Product Value
- Brand Lines: written by Discord to support "Imagine a Place" narrative, addressing general feeling or features
- Community Quotes: authentic quotes from community events (Snowsgiving, Workshops, server events) -- reflects that "Discord is something different to everyone"
- Three messaging pillars: "That Discord Feeling," "Community Belonging," and "Product Value"
- Voice style: "universal feeling of Discord with a metaphorical layer that transforms copy into conversation starters between friends"
- Uses community-specific lingo, witticism, double meanings -- "understood universally while it nods to the edges"
- Clever, playful twists on functional benefits (e.g., "Imagine a place to enjoy cookies without spilling your data")
- Separate downloadable Messaging Guidelines referenced

## Outliers
- Unusually large file (157MB, 74 pages) for a brand guidelines document -- likely image-heavy presentation format
- Three-tier messaging framework (Brand / Community / Product) is a sophisticated content strategy model
- Community-sourced quotes integrated into the brand system is distinctive
- "Imagine a Place" campaign framework allows infinite creative variations
